card.name: Subject starting a past-tense narrative sentence
card.fires_on: The subject word (mostly "I", also "He", "It", "The battle") that begins a new sentence or clause after a scene-setting phrase in past-tense personal or historical narrative. It expects a verb like "was", "felt" or "believed" next.

modes.label: First-person "I" in recollection
modes.description: The word "I" opens a clause telling what the writer felt or did, after an introductory phrase.
modes.example: When I first heard about the discovery of a potential obesity gene on the news,<< I>> ignored it.

modes.label: Third-person subject in history
modes.description: "He", "It" or "The battle" starts a sentence describing a past person or event.
modes.example: The<< battle>> was a demonstration of the effectiveness of the

card.writes: It favors words like remember, remain, recall and remains, which suggests a retrospective narration, and suppresses numbers and symbols.
card.plain: It marks the point in a story where the writer names who did or felt something in the past.
